highlights.title: Carney Calls for E.U.-Canada Pact Amid ‘Ferocious Storm’
highlights.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney told European lawmakers that an alliance would help to secure sovereignty and independence for his country. The moves come amid a historic low for U.S. ties with Canada.

highlights.title: Yemen escalation displaces more than 57,000 children: UNICEF
highlights.summary: Renewed fighting in Yemen is deepening an already severe humanitarian crisis in a country where more than 12 million children depend on aid, after more than a decade of conflict.

highlights.title: As freshwater reserves shrink, countries must prepare for a new water reality
highlights.summary: The world is entering a period in which abnormal water supplies are becoming the norm, with river flows, groundwater and glaciers all showing signs of sustained disruption, the UN weather agency warned on Thursday.

highlights.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
highlights.summary: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.

highlights.title: Flávio tem 53,7% e Lula tem 34,0% no 1º turno no PR, diz pesquisa
highlights.summary: AtlasIntel indica que o senador lidera também em um eventual 2º turno entre os eleitores do Estado
